APPLIED MATHEMATICS · INVERSE PROBLEMS · COMPUTATIONAL IMAGING

<h1 class="home-hero-title">
Turning physical measurements into biological insight
</h1>

<p class="home-hero-lead">
I develop mathematical and computational methods that turn indirect,
noisy and incomplete measurements into quantitative information for
biology and medicine — through inverse problems, optimization,
numerical analysis and machine learning.
</p>

<p class="home-hero-secondary">
My current research focuses on computational microscopy, where physical
modelling, acquisition and computation increasingly become part of the
same measurement process.
</p>
